source_summary: Winter Chinese landscape with ink-wash cliffs, snow banks, dark evergreen strokes, pink plum blossoms, small roofed buildings, a low bridge/railing, and broad misty water/sky reserves. Calligraphy and seals at lower left are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_misty_mountain_wash
motifs.description: Large pale ink-wash mountain mass rising behind the left-side scene, with soft grey-brown tonal blooms, feathered mist edges, and sparse contour hints. Isolate only the visible mountain wash and its irregular edge, excluding overlaid trees, blossoms, buildings, and paper marks.
must_preserve: soft diluted grey-brown wash gradients
irregular feathered mountain silhouette
subtle vertical and diagonal contour traces
misty edges where the wash fades into blank space

motifs.name: left_snowy_cliff_pines
motifs.description: Steep left foreground cliff and stacked dark evergreens, including snow-laden rock shelves and vertical pine clusters along the ridge. Exclude the lower-left calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: dark broken ink strokes defining pine foliage
blue-grey snow highlights on rock and needles
rough dry-brush cliff texture
stepped vertical rhythm of trees and ledges
soft grey wash shadows on snow banks

motifs.name: upper_plum_and_pine_cascade
motifs.description: Cascading branch cluster on the upper central cliff: dark pine needles and angular plum branches with many small pink-red blossoms descending along the cliff edge.
must_preserve: black angular branch linework
dense pink blossom dots
dark triangular pine-needle strokes
white snowy negative spaces between branches
thin brown ink twigs following the cliff edge

motifs.name: hidden_cliff_pavilion_group
motifs.description: Small roofed pavilion or cottage group tucked into the snowy middle-left cliff, with dark ink roof geometry, a small wall or doorway, surrounding rocks, pines, and plum branches.
must_preserve: sharp black roof outlines and eaves
small pale wall planes left as snow/negative space
dark rock base beneath the buildings
nearby pink plum blossoms on branching limbs
grey wash shadows binding buildings into the cliff

motifs.name: lower_left_plum_tree_bank
motifs.description: Foreground plum tree growing from the lower-left snowy bank, with two dark trunks, long arching branches, scattered pink blossoms, small rocks, and pale snow ground.
motifs.role: foreground flowering tree and snow bank
must_preserve: forked dark trunks with dry-brush texture
long sweeping branch arcs
individual pink blossom dots along twigs
small dark stones at the base
soft grey snow-bank wash and black edge strokes

motifs.name: central_plum_grove_rock_ledge
motifs.description: Dense central grove of plum trees on a rocky snow ledge, with several upright trunks, interlaced branches, pink blossoms, dark rock masses, and blue-grey snow accents.
must_preserve: multiple vertical dark trunks
fine branching network
clusters of pink blossom dots
dark ink rock bases and ledges
blue-grey snow highlights on rocks
soft wash transitions behind the grove

motifs.name: right_bridge_and_riverside_huts
motifs.description: Lower-right riverside settlement motif: low arched bridge or railing with dark posts, adjoining small hut roofs, snowy bank, and a partial plum branch at the far right.
must_preserve: dark angular bridge or railing posts
low sweeping bridge line
small roof forms with black eaves and pale walls
ochre-brown roof accents
snowy bank wash beneath the structures
partial pink-blossomed branch at right edge

motifs.name: misty_water_and_isolated_rocks
motifs.description: Open misty water or frozen river surface across the lower center-right, with pale grey wash, soft shoreline transitions, and several isolated dark rocks protruding from the water.
must_preserve: broad pale grey horizontal wash
soft cloud-like water edges
isolated dark ink rocks with blue-grey highlights
subtle shoreline shadowing
empty negative space that separates foreground from far bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
